newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UK's Prince Philip, Prince Charles arrive in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: UK's Prince Philip, Prince Charles arrive in Gulf.

text.p: Britain's Prince Philip and his son Prince Charles on Wednesday began separate visits to the Gulf region, British diplomats said.

The Duke of Edinburgh arrived in Abu Dhabi, capital of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), on a two-day working visit in his capacity as President Emeritus of the Geneva-based World Wide Fund for Nature (WWFN), the British embassy said in a statement.
The visit is part of an international tour that includes trips to Hungary, Turkey, Oman, Mongolia, Japan, Russia, the United States and Canada.
Higher Education Minister Sheikh Nahyan bin Mubarak al-Nahayan greeted Prince Philip at the airport. He will accompany him on a visit to a nature reserve on the nearby island of Sir Bani Yas.
UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan is also expected to meet Prince Philip, the husband of Britain's Queen Elizabeth.
Prince Charles arrived in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday on a two-day visit to meet senior Saudi princes and businessmen, the British embassy in Riyadh said.
The Prince of Wales is also due to visit Saudi Arabia's consultative Shura Council and meet with members of the British community in the kingdom, the embassy said in a statement.
Prince Charles recently made a tour of Saudi Arabia's Gulf Arab neighbours Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar.
